prompt: Create a stylish modern portrait collage featuring a young woman with long dark hair, fair skin, and an elegant calm expression. Use the same person consistently in every panel with identical facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and identity. Canvas: square 1:1 portrait-collage poster with a clean white background and rounded outer margins. Layout: use exactly 5 rounded rectangular photo panels with soft white borders and a minimal editorial design: 1 wide horizontal panel across the top showing a close-up black-and-white portrait leaning against a tree; 1 large central-left full-body cutout overlapping multiple panels, in color, wearing a dusty rose pink linen button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, beige trousers, sunglasses, and a wristwatch, hands in pockets, outlined with a thick soft white sticker-like border; 1 mid-right rounded panel showing a black-and-white seated or three-quarter portrait with sunglasses and one hand under the chin; 1 lower-right rounded panel showing a black-and-white smiling close-up looking upward while wearing sunglasses; 1 bottom-right rounded panel showing a smaller black-and-white full-body walking pose with hands in pockets. Visual style: premium lifestyle photography collage, soft natural daylight, shallow depth of field, blurred outdoor park or tree-lined background, cinematic grayscale panels contrasted with the single color foreground figure, polished magazine aesthetic, realistic skin and hair detail, subtle shadows where the cutout overlaps the panels. Color treatment: all background panels are monochrome black and white, while the main overlapping full-body portrait remains in natural color with the shirt emphasized in dusty rose pink. Constraints: exactly 5 photo panels plus 1 overlapping color cutout of the same person, rounded corners on every panel, thick white gutters between panels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, keep the composition balanced and clean.

promptZh: 创作一张时尚的现代肖像拼贴画，主角为 一位留着长黑发、皮肤白皙、神情优雅冷静的年轻女性。请确保每张面板中的人物保持一致，包括相同的面部特征、发型、肤色和身份。画布：方形 1:1 肖像拼贴海报，背景为简洁的白色，外缘采用圆角设计。布局：使用 5 个带柔和白色边框的圆角矩形照片面板，采用极简编辑风格：顶部 1 个宽横向面板，展示靠在树旁的黑白近景肖像；左侧中央 1 个大型全身剪影，以彩色呈现，身穿 一件干枯玫瑰粉色亚麻衬衫，袖口卷起，搭配米色长裤、太阳镜和腕表，双手插兜，边缘带有厚实的柔和白色贴纸边框；中右侧 1 个圆角面板，展示佩戴太阳镜、单手托腮的黑白坐姿或四分之三身肖像；右下侧 1 个圆角面板，展示佩戴太阳镜、抬头微笑的黑白近景；底部右侧 1 个圆角面板，展示一个较小的黑白全身行走姿势，双手插兜。视觉风格：高级生活方式摄影拼贴，柔和的自然日光，浅景深，背景为模糊的公园或林荫道，电影质感的灰度面板与单一彩色前景人物形成对比，精致的杂志美学，逼真的皮肤和头发细节，剪影覆盖在面板上时带有微妙的阴影。色彩处理：所有背景面板均为黑白单色，而重叠的全身肖像保持自然色彩，衬衫颜色突出显示为 干枯玫瑰粉色。约束条件：包含 5 个照片面板和 1 个重叠的同人物彩色剪影，所有面板均采用圆角，面板间留有宽阔的白色间隙，无文字、无标志、无水印、无额外人物，保持构图平衡且简洁。
